name: agentstack
description: Work Graph control plane for AgentStack. Use the bundled remote MCP connector at https://agentstack.tech/mcp.

interface.longDescription: Authorization is human-first: in Codex open this plugin → MCP Connectors → agentstack → Connect (OAuth at agentstack.tech; fallback https://agentstack.tech/mcp/connect), then the agent calls auth.get_profile via agentstack.execute. Never auth.login, Device Code, or a second MCP server on the directory path. After session_ready, bind context.project_id and call agents.work_next before catalog search. Do not silently create an anonymous project.
defaultPrompt: Help me connect AgentStack (Connect on the bundled MCP, then auth.get_profile).
What is the next Work Graph step on this project?
